name: Kingdom of Pontus
events: Ariobarzanes becomes the second king of Pontus, succeeding his father Mithridates I Ctistes.
Meanwhile, the birth of a son to Antiochus III and Laodice (daughter of Mithridates II, king of Pontus)…
Pharnaces I of Pontus decides to attack both Eumenes II of Pergamum and Ariarathes IV of Cappadocia and…
Mithridates V Euergetes succeeds his uncle Mithridates IV Philopator Philadelphus as king of Pontus.
Mithridates VI of Pontus invades Bithynia and Cappadocia, thus beginning the First Mithridatic War.
Lucius Licinius Murena, the Roman governor of Asia, clashes with the Pontic forces of Mithridates VI…
Cicero travels to Athens and then to Rhodes to continue his studies of philosophy and oratory.
The Senate sends Publius Servilius Vatia to Cilicia as governor, where he fights a successful campaign…
Pompey the Great subjugates the kingdom of Iberia and makes Colchis a Roman province.
Pompey destroys the kingdom of Pontus; king Mithridates VI commits suicide after escaping to the Crimea.
Pharnaces II becomes King of Pontus.
